description: Your magic is tied to the lunar cycles.

features.name: Lunar Spells
features.description: Learn moon phase spells. Full Moon=white magic, New Moon=black magic.

features.name: Lunar Empowerment
features.description: Gain bonus to spell save DC and rolls based on lunar phase.

features.name: Waxing and Waning Magic
features.description: Spend sorcery points to enhance spells based on lunar phase.

features.name: Lunar Eclipse
features.description: When eclipse occurs (30 feet from you), gain powerful magic effects.
